description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'CoapErrorResponse' that provides static methods to handle and send error responses over CoAP exchanges, including converting exceptions and HTTP status codes into CoAP response codes.

classes.name: CoapErrorResponse
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to send error responses in CoAP exchanges, including mapping exceptions to CoAP response codes.

methods.name: isTemporaryError
methods.description: Checks if a Throwable cause indicates a temporary error that can be retried.

methods.name: respond
methods.description: Overloaded methods to respond to a CoapExchange with an error cause, optionally with a default response code.

methods.name: toCoapCode
methods.description: Maps a Throwable cause to a corresponding CoAP ResponseCode, with a default fallback.
